summary: RFC 5727 defined processes for the former Real-time Applications and Infrastructure area, including evolution of SIP and related protocols and the operation of the DISPATCH and SIPCORE working groups. This best current practice updates RFC 5727 to allow more flexibility in how such working groups and the SIP change process are run.

eli5.summary: This is a rules update for how a group of engineers decides where new work on a calling protocol should go. The updated rules give them more room to pick what works.
